ngaap.guidance: 2023 guidance (initiated 26-Jan-2023, including TDL): Revenue $17.4B - $17.8B (up 2% to 4%; vs prior year $17.1B); segment operating income $2.7B - $2.8B (vs prior year $2.6B); segment operating margin 15.2% - 15.7% (vs 15.4%); non-GAAP EPS $12.00 - $12.50 (vs $12.90; bridge: 2022 $12.90, pension impact $(0.71), operations $(0.10), other $(0.02), share count $0.18 -> $12.25 mid-point); adjusted free cash flow $2.0B+ (net of ~$400M - $500M R&D-related cash tax payments). By segment (2022 recast for realignment of ~$300M classified programs from IMS to SAS, effective 2023): IMS revenue $6.5B - $6.7B (vs $6.6B), operating income $800M - $850M (vs $861M); SAS $6.4B - $6.5B (vs $6.4B), $700M - $750M (vs $745M); CS $4.8B - $4.9B incl. ~$400M TDL (vs $4.2B), $1,150M - $1,200M (vs $1,022M). Supplemental: net FAS/CAS pension adjustment ~$375M (vs $536M; FAS pension service cost ~(25), CAS pension cost ~(100), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~75, non-service FAS pension income ~300); net interest expense ~$400M (vs $279M); acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses ~$100M; L3Harris merger-related integration expenses ~$0; non-GAAP effective tax rate 13% - 14% (vs 13.9%); average diluted shares ~191M (vs 193M); capex ~$275M.
ngaap.notes: Reconciliation format changed in the Q4-22 letter: non-GAAP EPS is now built from net income from continuing operations plus a list of adjustments in $ ('Total adjustments after taxes') and a single 'per share amount of above adjustments'; segment tables give 'Non-GAAP operating income' by segment (GAAP segment operating income excluding impairment of goodwill and other assets). Adjustment definitions (letter p.21): amortization of acquisition-related intangibles; L3Harris merger-related integration expenses; acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses (TDL and pending AJRD; new in 4Q22); pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related expenses; business divestiture-related gains; gain on sale of asset group; impairment of goodwill and other assets; charges for severance and other termination costs; charge related to an additional pre-merger legal contingency; non-operating income adjustments. Pension (FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income) is NOT excluded. 'Income taxes on above adjustments' is +17 in 4Q22 (as printed). Adjusted FCF = operating cash flow less net capex plus cash used for L3Harris merger integration, cash used for acquisition-related transaction and integration costs (new) and net cash paid for income taxes on divestitures. FCF bridge is the quarter column; cf is 12 months. No adjusted EBIT published (GAAP EBIT 607, 13.3%).
